hand_read.summary: Ghos (Kid Icarus). Faces the camera and drifts after the nearest fighter in the aerial module's slip homing (two parameter sets, 96 % / 4 %, re-picked every 20-40 frames), bouncing off walls / floors / ceilings; hit: a stun of hit_return_frame() frames, then flies again; leaves after 1200 frames without hitting or being hit. Its body hurts all the time while it flies.
hand_read.read: enemy_fs.cro (update): create 0x11560, ctor 0x11598 (EnemyAerialModuleImpl at +0x168, set_motion_label without hashsets, no set_damage_motion_label), start 0x109C0, states: 1 0x1091C / 0x10E24, 2 0x10AD0 / 0x10EE4, 3 0x10DD0 / 0x10F78, 4 0x10E84 / 0x1105C, 5 remove; helpers L66BA4 (slip-homing pick), L1120C (bounce); slots 11 notify_on_damage 0x11094, 28 notify_on_remove 0x11140, 31 0x113F0, 55 0x10B9C, 69 0x113A4; slots 64-66 = 1, 67 = 4. code.bin: EnemyAerialModuleImpl::set_mode_slip_homing 0x5F5F58, update 0x5F66AC, GroundCollisionObject::get_ground_normal 0x96A538, Behavior::hit_return_frame 0x9EA9B0 (factor 0x9EB4C0, damage 0x9EAAB4), init_common_leave 0x7B23B4, finalize_common_leave 0x7B475C.

states.1: Fly: kinetic 26, L66BA4 (timer = random(P@0x8C 20, P@0x90 40); random_choice(96, 4) -> set_mode_slip_homing(P7 entry 0 / 1: s0 +0, s1 +0xC, s2 +8, s3 +0x14, s4 +4, s5 +0x10)), ground off, passable on, FlyHoming loop, aerial set_target(the start's nearest fighter, 0). Update: aerial update; the timer runs out -> L66BA4; L1120C; the leave timer (P@0xA0 1200) runs out -> 3.
states.2: Stun (slot 69): kinetic 16, ground off, passable on, DamageStart once, frames = hit_return_frame(), mesh 1 off / 0 on, kinetic flag |= 0x80; the frames run out: flag cleared, meshes back, -> 1.
states.4: Dead: DamageStart at rate 0, bullet(), meshes 1 off / 0 on; kinetic flag 8 -> 5.

danger.note: node 3 = jtb entry 2 = HipN; on while it flies

hand_read.contact: yes in state 1 (fly: power 3, angle 361, kbg 50, bkb 50, size 8, node 3 HipN); the defeated body (state 4: kbg 100). No explicit attack calls; no ACMD (no hashsets, no animcmd files).
hand_read.targeting: start: the nearest fighter (kept); aerial slip homing toward it; slot 55 turns node 2 and the posture toward it (rx = -dy 30, ry = dx 30 degrees: not ported).
hand_read.kinetics: slip homing (code.bin 0x5F5F58: mode 2, energy 0 re-initialised with its current speed, params +0x10..+0x24, energy 0 on / 1 off, target point = position); bounce L1120C: on is_touch(0xFF), r = |v|^2 / 0.8^2; r < 0.1 (and r <= 1): nothing; v reflected on get_ground_normal(0xFF) (the sum of the touched lines' normals, normalised), normalised, times 0.6 min(r, 1) -> set_current_speed.
hand_read.damage: slot 11 notify_on_damage: (a weapon / held item / flagged attack per slot 31 restores the HP with init_damage) BehaviorImpl::notify_on_damage, stop_se, the leave timer = 1200. Slot 69 (called by it): a running leave finalised + set_correct(5), => 2, returns 1 (the framework's own reaction skipped). hit_return_frame = int(int(gl +0x154) x f), f = gl +0x160 + (gl +0x164 - gl +0x160) (clamp(d, gl +0x158, gl +0x15C) - gl +0x158) / (gl +0x15C - gl +0x158), d = DamageModule +0x6C; the Wii U gl file's ghos entry (index kind + 1): +0x154 30, +0x158 1, +0x15C 80, +0x160 2, +0x164 1.
hand_read.death: state 4 (bullet); leave state 3 after 1200 frames (reset by being hit).
